content.summary: Accept this exact manuscript for round 10 within the chief review mandate. I reread the final bytes and verified both frozen hashes. The contribution and assurance limits remain accurate, and the committed owners explicitly resolved all three outstanding round-8 items. No required revision remains from my review. The separately requested final audit is still distinct from this decision.

checks.scope: Final mathematical statement and contradiction scope
checks.method: Compared the final support-53 claim with the manifest-verified expanded literal theorem and recomputed its terminal arithmetic.
checks.observation: The literal theorem quantifies over Type u, requires exactly 28 distinct rank-four members, permits empty sunflower cores, and bounds the actual union by 53. The final proof requires 12(378-4)=4488; its stated tuple gives L=31, U=875 and score 4475, leaving margin 13. The manuscript still claims a finite reduction, with exclusion, sharpness and extremal improvement unproved.

checks.scope: Final-text binding and committed repair closure
checks.method: Verified F38 review, computation and script hash links against the current manuscript; inspected the public resolution entries.
checks.observation: Both text-comparison records bind exactly to the final manuscript despite recording the preceding snapshot. Their corpus and originality limitations remain explicit. Each typography/link obligation has an owner revision marked resolved, and the outstanding-issue map is empty. These checks support exact-version acceptance without claiming independent certification or completed publication.
